Source states: 'L'épidémie du choléra dans la zone de responsabilité de Mbrao, District Sanitaire de YOUE, Délégation Sanitaire Provinciale du Mayo Kebi EST a commencé le 12 juillet 2019 par 02 cas de Gastro- Entérites dont la confirmation a été faite par le Laboratoire'. Evidence type: Inferred_Absence. Surveillance system status during absence: operational. National total - includes provinces not individually listed. Inferred absence for ISO weeks 16-26 of 2019 (2019-04-15..2019-06-30), unobserved in the JHU/UNICEF weekly baseline, which shows national zero weeks through 2019-04-08..14 and again from 2019-07-08. The MoH dates the start of the 2019 epidemic (Youé district, Mayo-Kebbi Est) to 12 July 2019, the first cholera in Chad since the Salamat/Sila outbreak that ended in January 2018 (IFRC MDRTD016 final report, meta 63), so no cases are expected in this window. Inferred rather than Documented because the source gives an onset date, not a statement about the preceding weeks. 1-11 July 2019 left uncovered on purpose, to avoid the imprecise legacy rows 12-13 that start 2019-07-01 (Agent 5 to adjudicate) and because the index death occurred in Cameroon before 12 July. Note also a baseline conflict: JHU/UNICEF week 2019-07-08..14 = 0, while this SITREP reports 2 cases on 12 July and 3 on 13-14 July. Regional cross-check: Cameroon ACTIVE (same V. cholerae O1 Inaba 'le même type qui circule au Cameroun'; index case died across the border), so confidence held at 0.6. Agent 3 (B2-Q9).
